=== Description===

:''See [[Dwarf Fortress Wiki:Quality]]''

Rating timestamps can be either be updated with the rating script or by replacing the current timestamp with 5 tildes (<code><nowiki>~~~~~</nowiki></code>).

'''Note:''' this is a high-use template and rebuilding pages that use it can take a long time. Avoid making more edits than necessary (if possible), and allow time for cache regeneration. <!-- or whatever it's called --> To rebuild a certain page, you can add <code>?action=purge</code> after its URL or make a [[wikipedia:Help:Purge#Null edit|null edit]] to that page. Ideally, wait until server load is low -- you can check how many jobs are waiting to be processed [http://dwarffortresswiki.org/api.php?action=query&meta=siteinfo&siprop=statistics&format=yamlfm here]. If the number is high, you should wait until the server is less busy. (The server could currently be regenerating pages).

=== Usage ===
To mark an item "Fine": <pre><nowiki>{{Quality|Fine}}</nowiki></pre>

To mark an item "Superior": <pre><nowiki>{{Quality|Superior}}</nowiki></pre>

=== Feedback ===
